title: Kissed Turkish Cannellini Bean Stew
description: A garlicky, tender stew of cannellini beans cooked sous-vide and finished in a bright lemony broth, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Rinse and drain the cannellini beans, then place them in a vacuum-sealable bag with minced garlic, bay leaves, diced onion, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and vegetable broth.
Seal the bag and cook in the sous-vide bath for 60 minutes.
Remove the bag, discard the bay leaves and onion pieces, and transfer the beans to a pot.
Heat 1 teaspoon of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add a minced garlic clove, and sauté until fragrant.
Add the sous-vide beans to the saucepan, stir in lemon juice, and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors meld.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the stew before serving.
Optional: squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top for extra brightness.
